title: Draft section mapping for remaining POSH duties
limitations: This repository file is a companion to the controlled Drive section-mapping workbook and is not the legal source of truth.
No mapping entry activates a deterministic rule, retrieval chunk, endpoint, provider call, or UI surface.
Page references marked pending must be verified against the exact registered file hash before legal review or RAG approval.
Complaint content, case details, personal data, and raw assessment answers must not be included in governed chunks or provider requests.

features.dutyOrLegalQuestion: Does the employer have a current and appropriately disseminated POSH policy or declaration supported by evidence?
customerWordingLimitations: Do not state that a policy is legally approved or fully compliant.

sourceMappings.purpose: Employer duties and supporting implementation obligations
Internal policy or declaration and dissemination

features.dutyOrLegalQuestion: Is there evidence of employee awareness and Internal Committee orientation or capacity-building activity?
customerWordingLimitations: Do not certify training quality or legal sufficiency from attendance evidence alone.

sourceMappings.purpose: Workshops and awareness programmes plus committee orientation
Orientation awareness capacity building contact details and official modules

features.dutyOrLegalQuestion: Are required POSH notices and Internal Committee details evidenced at each relevant location?
customerWordingLimitations: Do not generalise evidence from one location to all offices or administrative units.

sourceMappings.purpose: Display of penal consequences and the order constituting the Internal Committee
Names and contact details of committee members

features.dutyOrLegalQuestion: Are privacy-safe complaint routes process controls timelines confidentiality and record controls defined without exposing case content?
customerWordingLimitations: Never send complaint narratives names allegations evidence findings or case-level statistics to the explanation provider.

sourceMappings.purpose: Complaint inquiry confidentiality appeal and related process controls
Prescribed complaint and inquiry procedure details

features.privacyBoundary: Only control-presence booleans dates owners and evidence references may be assessed. No case content is permitted.

features.dutyOrLegalQuestion: Does the Internal Committee composition and office or administrative-unit coverage have sufficient evidence for deterministic review?
customerWordingLimitations: Do not infer per-unit coverage from total company headcount or a single committee record.

sourceMappings.purpose: Committee constitution member composition and multi-unit coverage
Fees or allowances for the external member

features.dutyOrLegalQuestion: Is annual-report preparation submission and employer reporting evidenced using privacy-safe aggregate fields?
customerWordingLimitations: Use aggregate control evidence only and do not expose complaint details.

sourceMappings.purpose: Committee annual report and employer annual reporting duties

features.privacyBoundary: Only aggregate counts and control evidence are permitted. No names allegations evidence or case narratives.
